subject: english
prompt: 在2021年11月25日河川觀測站晨間課堂活動中，在「2-Ⅳ-12：引導式討論」能力練習中，Which sentence best summarizes this message: 'Please bring a reusable bottle on Friday.'？

options.text: Students should bring a reusable bottle on Friday.
Students should bring a new desk on Monday.
The bottle is not allowed on Friday.
The message is about a school holiday.

answer.explanation: The summary keeps the item and the day stated in the message. 本題對應 KG「2-Ⅳ-12：引導式討論」，情境為2021年11月25日河川觀測站晨間。
